descriptionHtml:
Designed for bridesmaid moments and beyond, this elegant dress features a refined A-line silhouette that flatters a range of body types. The soft, flowing fabric drapes beautifully for ceremonies, dinners, and formal events, offering a polished look that transitions effortlessly from weddings to evening occasions.

Fit: Please refer to size chart.

Length: Floor length.

 

Sleeve Style: Sleeveless.

 

Closure: It is concealed a zipper up the back.

 

Undergarments: It is not padded, with lining.

 

Fabric: The garment comprises sequin.

 

Stretch: Fabric is no stretch.
